skygo --json state retention enable --data-dir $DATA --request-window 1h
retention-domain DOMAIN
server start
taskfile task.json success
# Dropped actual discovery cannot trigger compatibility submission.
drop-response /skygo.v1.ControlService/GetRetention
! skygo --endpoint $PROXY run -f task.json
stderr 'unavailable'
event-count 0
calls SubmitJob 0
calls SubmitRetainedJob 0
# Auth failures and actual-reply corruption cannot authorize fallback either.
env SKYGO_TOKEN=
! skygo --token wrong run -f task.json
stderr 'unauthenticated'
env SKYGO_TOKEN=coverage-token
discovery-fault malformed
! skygo run -f task.json
stderr .
discovery-fault permission
! skygo run -f task.json
stderr 'permission_denied'
calls SubmitJob 0
calls SubmitRetryJob 0
calls SubmitRetainedJob 0
event-count 0
# A supplied ID never silently becomes fresh current-domain work.
! skygo run -f task.json --request-id possible-old-retry
stderr 'explicit request domain required'
calls SubmitJob 1
calls PlanTask 0
event-count 0
# Lose an accepted explicit submission, then replay exactly the original hint.
drop-response /skygo.v1.ControlService/SubmitRetainedJob
! skygo --endpoint $PROXY run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id lost
stderr '^request-domain: '$DOMAIN'\nrequest-id: lost\ntask-file: "task.json"\n'
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id lost --wait
job-id JOB
event-count 1
# Fresh path: no caller-supplied ID or domain. Lose the accepted actual response.
drop-response /skygo.v1.ControlService/SubmitRetainedJob
! fresh-run
fresh-order
save-fresh-hint $DOMAIN fresh.hint
skygo --json run -f $FRESH_TASK --request-domain $FRESH_DOMAIN --request-id $FRESH_ID --wait
same-hint fresh.hint
job-id FRESH_JOB
event-count 2
calls GetRetention 6
calls SubmitRetainedJob 4
calls SubmitJob 1
calls SubmitRetryJob 0
calls PlanTask 0
server stop
! stderr .
